{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import subprocess
import json
import time

notebook_id = '4c5c9eee-df32-45ca-a7bc-5a8d3648120b'

try:
    with open('urls.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-16') as f:
        all_urls = [line.strip('\ufeff').strip() for line in f if line.strip()]
    original_300 = [u for u in all_urls if u.startswith('http')][:300]
except Exception as e:
    exit(1)

res = subprocess.run(['notebooklm', 'source', 'list', '-n', notebook_id, '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(res.stdout)
current_urls = [source.get('url') for source in data.get('sources', []) if source.get('url')]

missing_urls = set(original_300) - set(current_urls)
print(f'Found {len(missing_urls)} missing URLs out of 300.')

if missing_urls:
    print('\nRetrying 3 missing URLs...')
    for url in list(missing_urls)[:3]:
        print(f'\nRetrying: {url}')
        add_res = subprocess.run(['notebooklm', 'source', 'add', url, '-n', notebook_id, '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if add_res.returncode == 0:
            print('SUCCESS')
        else:
            print(f'FAILED: {add_res.stdout.strip()}')
        time.sleep(2)
